sector_news.headline: Dwarka Expressway vs Golf Course Extension: Which Gurugram micromarket offers more value for money?
sector_news.figure: Golf Course Road Extension average apartment price Rs 22,000/sq ft in 2025 (vs Rs 18,000/sq ft on Dwarka Expressway); Anarock cites Gurugram overall rising Rs 9,500/sq ft (Q3 2024) to Rs 12,250/sq ft (2025), up 29%

sector_news.headline: SPR, Sohna emerge as South Gurugram's next real estate growth engines as prices surge
sector_news.figure: SPR (Southern Peripheral Road) average residential price ~Rs 16,249/sq ft in 2026, up 18.4% YoY and 165% over 5 years (from ~Rs 9,800/sq ft); Magicbricks data

sector_news.headline: Gurugram's Southern Peripheral Road emerges as key real estate market
sector_news.figure: SPR property prices surged ~125% between Dec 2022 and Dec 2025, average now exceeding Rs 17,000/sq ft; new elevated stretch (Vatika Chowk to NH-48) improves access from Sector 58 to Sector 115
